# BARRACUDA RESTO PUB — ABUJA, NIGERIA
> Casual rooftop restaurant, seafood & charcoal grills, cocktails, and welcoming pub in Wuse 2, Abuja.

## Overview
Barracuda Resto Pub is a welcoming rooftop restaurant and pub situated on the rooftop of Yelwa Plaza along 111 Adetokunbo Ademola Crescent in Wuse 2, Abuja, Nigeria. The venue combines authentic Nigerian charcoal grills and seafood with cold refreshments, craft cocktails, open-air terrace seating, and weekly social dance and entertainment evenings (Cuban Salsa, Karaoke, and Kizomba).

- Website: https://barracuda-resto-pub.vercel.app
- Address: 111 Adetokunbo Ademola Crescent, Wuse 2, Abuja (rooftop, Yelwa Plaza), FCT, Nigeria
- Telephone: +234 912 235 6336
- WhatsApp Concierge: +234 912 235 6336
- Instagram: @barracuda_restpub
- Primary Dining Style: Casual Rooftop Restaurant & Pub, Charcoal Grills, Seafood, Cocktails

## Official Operating Hours (West Africa Time, WAT / UTC+1)
- Monday – Saturday: 10:00 AM – 12:00 AM (Midnight)
- Sunday: 12:00 PM (Noon) – 12:00 AM (Midnight)

## Venue Spaces & Experiences
1. Charcoal Grills & Seafood: Fresh tiger prawns, whole croaker fish, goat asun, and charcoal-grilled skewers.
2. The Central Rooftop Bar: Well-stocked bar serving signature cocktails, cold beers, wines, and refreshments.
3. Rooftop Breeze Terrace: Open-air terrace seating overlooking Wuse 2, perfect for lunch, evening dining, and relaxing.
4. Indoor Pub Lounge & Tables: Casual indoor dining tables and comfortable seating for friends, colleagues, and family meals.
5. Dancefloor & Social Area: Dedicated open space for weekly salsa socials, karaoke performances, and private celebrations.

## Weekly Entertainment Schedule (Sample Schedule — Follow @barracuda_restpub for updates)
- Cuban Salsa & Timba Night: Every Tuesday (6:00 PM – 11:30 PM) • Social dancing, beginners workshop, authentic Cuban rhythms. Entry: ₦3,000.
- Wednesday Karaoke Night: Every Wednesday (7:00 PM – 11:30 PM) • Sing your favorite hits, hosted by resident MC, happy hour drink specials. Entry: Free.
- Salsa & Kizomba Night: Every Thursday (6:00 PM – 11:30 PM) • Sensual bachata, kizomba, and cross-body salsa social dancing. Entry: ₦3,000.
- Bachata & Afro-Latin Socials: Every Saturday (7:00 PM – 12:00 AM) • Latin hits, Afro-fusion beats, social dancing, and rooftop cocktails. Entry: Free.
